docs.text: HSE CS Open Source A collection of open-source projects and resources created by HSE CS staff and students, including research code, courses, and other educational and technical resources. ⭐ If you find a project useful, please consider starring this repository and the projects listed below. It helps make these resources more visible and supports the people who created them.
